title: View of the interior of Church of the Good Shepherd, Hartford, Conn. (Erected by Mrs. Samuel Colt.) (NYPL b11707680-G90F072 003F)
blurb: * Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger. Views of Hartford, Connecticut: includes street views, including parade scenes; park views including one of a gathering of the Ancient and Honorable Artillery; a view of the Connecticut River and shipbuilding; many views of the Church of the Good Shepherd, including interiors; Armsmear, home of the Elizabeth H. (Mrs. Samuel) Colt showing a gazebo, the pond and swans and the house; Mark Twain's house; Mr. Boynton's house in East Hartford; view of the Retreat for the Insane; Connecticut Mutual Life Insurance Company building, Charter Oak Life Insurance building; the Mulberry St. Bridge. Statement of responsibility : by R.S. De Lamater.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.14% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (1.76% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
